requested_assets.prompt:
Use case: logo-brand.
Asset type: original compact SYMBOL ONLY for IMD Lab engineering research website header, positioned LEFT of the site's separately rendered "IMD Lab" wordmark.
Output: one 1:1 square PNG image, 1024x1024, genuinely transparent background with alpha, no opaque canvas.
Style/medium: crisp flat 2D vector-like identity design, clean geometric silhouettes, professional and durable engineering lab character. Heavy simple forms and generous negative-space gaps readable at 40px.
Composition: a single centered compact symbol, approximately 80% of the canvas width and height, optically balanced with ample clear space. No mockup, no presentation board.
Color palette: dark navy #142a42 primary, optional steel blue #4f7b91, restrained small lime #c5df83 accent.
Constraints: original identity with no copying or reference brand marks; no wordmark, no "Lab", no captions, no readable text beyond the requested abstract monogram in concept 02.
Avoid: gradients, 3D perspective/rendering, textures, drop shadows, photography, fine lines, atom/gear/flask/lightning-bolt clipart, decorative background.
Primary request: Design an original integrated-layers symbol: three offset solid parallelogram/slab shapes, joined by a single substantial vertical structural edge into one compact engineered mark. The three slabs are closely stacked with clean clear negative-space intervals. Use navy for the main slabs and a small lime interface where structure joins. The geometry should convey layered engineered integration, not an isometric stack or 3D object. Overall silhouette robust, distinctive, and crisply 2D.

Primarily navy, no accent necessary. Ensure the result reads as one memorable emblem with bold geometry and large clear internal voids at 40px.
